card.name: Start of un- words in adverse event lists
card.fires_on: The word-start "un" (and sometimes "of", "Re", "ste") that opens a word inside a list of adverse effects or findings, such as un|responsiveness, un|steady, un|opposed, un|explained.

modes.label: un- opening a symptom
modes.description: The piece "un" begins a negative-sounding word in a list of symptoms or effects.
modes.example: acute neurotoxicity manifested by tremor, hyperreflexia,<< un>>steady gait, and dizziness.

modes.label: Other word starts or linking words
modes.description: A linking word or a word-start before an adverse event term, as in incidence of nausea or risk of rejection.
modes.example: There were no differences in the incidence<< of>> nausea and vomiting between patients receiving Desfl

card.writes: It suppresses words like episode, spell and history, so it steers the next word away from those and toward finishing the word being spelled.
card.plain: It fires when a symptom word starts with "un", like unresponsiveness or unsteady, in a list of side effects.
